faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoFab Machinery automatic band saws

faq.q: Roller feed or shuttle vise — which is better?
faq.a: Roller feed (NF-A 12) is simple and fast for bar and tube in straight cuts. A shuttle vise (NF-A 12 SC, NF-A 13) grips the bar and moves it a set distance per stroke, which is more accurate and handles bundles; the CNC saws (NF-A 14 to NF-A 24) position the feeder with a servo motor for the best repeatability.
The NF-A 12 T (0°–60° mitre head), the NF-A 13 (bow swivels both sides) and the NF-A 14, 16 and 18 with an automatic rotary bow (45°; 60° on the NF-A 18).

faq.q: Do automatic saws need a roller table?
faq.a: The NF-A 13 ships with a 20 ft material stand; for the other models a roller conveyor is optional and strongly recommended for bars longer than about 6 ft.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
